From: Jared Lim <jared.lim@atlashealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Deletion request: Atlas Health prompts & logs purge

Dylan —

We need to initiate a full purge for the Atlas Health production tenant (atlas-prod) relating to the PatientAssist integration. Scope required:
- All user prompts and assistant outputs (past 24 months)
- Derived embeddings and any cached vectors
- KV-store entries, ephemeral caches and prefix/KV caches
- Inference request logs and request trace IDs (audit logs)
- Any derivative metrics/explanations stored in analytics indexes

We require: (1) estimated completion window, (2) clear description of proof artifacts you will deliver (manifests, checksums), and (3) whether any data will be retained for billing/audit and for how long.

I can provide the tenant id, example trace ids, and a signed acceptance form from our legal team. We need this completed within your standard SLA or faster if possible — please advise.

Thanks,
Jared Lim
Head of Security
Atlas Health, Inc.
jared.lim@atlashealth.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Hi Jared —

Thanks for the details and the form — received. We can run this purge. High-level plan and asks below so we have a clear mutual action plan: 

1) Intake & scope confirmation
   - I'll open ticket SUP-6321 and link your signed form. Please confirm the exact tenant id (confirm: atlas-prod) and the date range (you mentioned 24 months — confirm start date).

2) Proposed runbook (summary)
   - Freeze ingest for tenant during sweep window (to avoid new writes).
   - Snapshot current metadata for traceability (read-only manifest).
   - Execute targeted purge: prompts, outputs, KV, cached vectors, request traces.
   - Generate proof bundle: manifest.json (list of deleted object ids), SHA256 checksums, and a short runbook log (operator steps + timestamps).
   - Upload proof bundle to a secure transfer link and provide an erase certificate.

3) Timeline
   - Typical turnaround: 48–72 hours after scope confirmation for hosted tenants. If you require a tighter window we can escalate (may need Dedicated window or a maintenance slot).

4) Questions
   - Do you want derivative embeddings removed as part of this sweep? (They can be included but may extend runtime.)
   - Any specific retention exceptions (e.g., legal hold)?

I've attached our standard erase acknowledgement template (erase_ack_template.docx) that we use to capture acceptance and sign-off. Once you confirm scope, we will schedule the operation and copy your security contact on the proof delivery.

I'll CC Operations for execution.

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Dylan / Connor —

I'll take the lead on execution once we have tenant confirmation from Jared. Draft execution checklist below (operational steps with artifacts we produce):

Pre-checks (T-0)
- Confirm tenant id and freeze ingestion: run `redwood-tenant freeze --tenant atlas-prod --window 60m`.
- Snapshot metadata: `redwood-snapshot --tenant atlas-prod --out snapshot-RBW-20261021.tar.gz` (store in secure bucket).

Purge execution (T+X)
- Run target purge: `redwood-erase --tenant atlas-prod --scope prompts,outputs,kv,kv-cache,vectors,request-traces --manifest RBW-20261021-AH`
- Collect per-step logs: `/var/log/redwood/erase/RBW-20261021-AH.log` and `/var/log/redwood/kv-evict/2026-10-21.log`.
- If any keys require zeroization, coordinate with KMS team (KMS request RBW-KMS-172).

Post-run verification
- Generate manifest RBW-20261022-manifest.json (IDs + object types + deletion timestamps).
- Compute checksums (SHA256) for the manifest and bundle.
- Produce erase certificate (erase_certificate_AtlasHealth.pdf) signed by Ops lead.

Proof delivery
- Bundle: RBW-proof-archive-AtlasHealth-20261022.zip
- Upload to secure transfer (one-time link) and provide an audit trail entry in HubSpot (HubSpot:21094).

Notes / exceptions
- Derived embeddings: these are stored in vector-index shards. Deleting them will require shard compaction — expect +4–8 hours additional processing for large indexes.
- Billing/audit logs: We will not remove billing records required by our finance team until legal acceptance; minimal billing metadata may persist for reconciliation unless you instruct otherwise.

Connor — please prepare the erase command and ensure the RBW-20261021-AH manifest is staged. I will request a KMS zeroization slot if necessary.

Marissa Cole
Senior Operations Lead, Data Integrity
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
